target_metric: steady-state synthesis RTF (synth_seconds / audio_seconds, lower is better)

sentences: 这是苹果芯片平台的合成测试。
数字归一化检查：12306 次列车准点到达。
performance-nex 要求先建立基线再做单变量假设轮换，同负载重测并保留正确性证据。
Apple Silicon 与 Intel 的核心拓扑差异显著：性能核与能效核的异构调度会改变 ONNX Runtime 线程池的行为，因此线程数必须在目标平台上独立实测，不能跨平台复用结论。
workload.state: warm (engine loaded + warmup synthesis before timing)

environment_identity.co_tenants: ttsd launchd daemon idle during measurement (CPU≈0), recorded as known noise source

baseline_config.provenance: Intel perf-20260922, never validated on ARM

hypotheses.rationale: M4 Pro 8P+4E heterogeneous topology: threads>8 spill onto E-cores; Intel-uniform-core optimum (4) may not transfer. One variable at a time, others fixed.

correctness_contract: per-sentence int16 PCM output must be bit-exact vs baseline threads=4 (np.array_equal + sha256); if bit-exactness fails, fall back to max-abs-sample-diff < 1/32768 tolerance with explicit downgrade note
significance_rule: config beats baseline only if median RTF delta > 2x baseline CV and direction holds across all repeats
platform_isolation_requirement: measured ARM optimum is written ONLY to arm64 section of per-platform config; x86_64 section keeps Intel-measured value 4 untouched; isolation verified by config load assertion
acceptance: a threads value with statistically significant RTF improvement over baseline AND bit-exact correctness AND isolated per-platform config shipped with load-verification
nearest_verifier: bench harness stderr/stdout + config isolation assertion + ttsd restart log
rollback: revert config.toml threads section + moss_engine.py platform lookup (git checkout)
